name: GL_ESSBASE_DAILY_BAL_DELTA
description: This table contains sets of incremental average balances that need to be applied to an Oracle Essbase cube.

columns.name: DELTA_RUN_ID
columns.description: Set of incremental average balance data this row belongs to.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger of the incremental average balance data.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Account of the incremental average balance data.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the incremental average balance data.

columns.name: CURRENCY_TYPE
columns.description: Currency type of the incremental average balance data. Valid values are U (cumulative balance), E (foreign currency entered balance), C (converted balance), T (up-to-date translated balance), and O (out-of-date translated balance).

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period of the incremental average balance data.

columns.name: CONVERTED_FROM_CURRENCY
columns.description: Currency that amounts were converted from. Contains a single space if the balance is not a converted balance.

columns.name: FIX_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of incremental fix to the Oracle Essbase balance. Valid values are ADD and REMOVE.

columns.name: PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: First date of the period of the incremental average balance data.

columns.name: PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: Last date of the period of the incremental average balance data.

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
